items.title: Travis Head pips star duo to win second-straight Allan Border Medal
items.description: Swashbuckling batter Travis Head's big year — including three Ashes centuries — wins him a second straight Allan Border Medal, with fellow Ashes heroes Alex Carey and Mitchell Starc hot on his heels.

items.title: Live: Morris dominates first half as Brisbane puts Hawthorn to the sword
items.description: Logan Morris kicks four goals in the first half as the Lions put down a marker against the Hawks at the Gabba. Follow live.

items.title: China accused as Pacific nations block statement condemning missile test
items.description: Naoero and Kiribati stir frustration at the opening day of the Pacific Islands Forum by blocking a regional statement criticising China's ballistic missile test.

items.title: ACCC launches inquiry into food labelling claims after Four Corners investigation
items.description: Australia's consumer watchdog has launched an inquiry into allegations of misleading consumer conduct after a major Four Corners investigation examining food fraud.

items.title: Men to be offered prostate screening from age 45 under new guidelines
items.description: New guidelines released today will change the way men are screened for prostate cancer and lead to less invasive testing.

items.title: Live: Bulldogs threaten upset as three-try blitz stuns high-flying Roosters
items.description: The New Zealand Warriors have made a premiership statement, hammering the ladder-leading Penrith Panthers 28-12. Follow live.

items.title: Visa overstayers to have work rights revoked if asylum claim rejected
items.description: The federal government is expected to take a hard line on temporary visas as it continues to consider ways to reduce Australia's migration figures.

items.title: Racism, hate after Voice referendum caused 'untold harm', inquiry hears
items.description: Aboriginal community-controlled organisations have told the federal racism inquiry that racial bias on the part of child protection workers and police is harming First Nations women and children.

items.title: Victoria announces poultry lockdown as bird flu cases spread
items.description: Testing confirmed a further 20 cases of H5N1avian influenza in Victoria on Friday, all in greater crested terns along the state's south-west coast.

items.title: Fourteen-year-old killed grandparents before deadly school rampage, Thai police say
items.description: At least seven people, including teachers and students, have died after a student opened fire at a school in Thailand.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
